newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Prices fall 0.79 pct in Nicaragua in August.
newsitem.headline: Prices fall 0.79 pct in Nicaragua in August.

text.p: Nicaraguan prices fell 0.79 percent in August, led by falling food and clothing prices, Nicaragua's Central Bank reported on Monday.
August's figures meant Nicaragua's accumulated inflation in 1996 fell to 4.84 percent.
The monthly cost of basic goods -- food, clothing and household products for a family of six -- fell by 17.55 cordobas ($2.55) in August to 1,233.92 cordobas ($143.48).
State workers such as teachers and nurses earn about $60 per month.
